source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Warlock Skyrunners gain **[Support](vsdata:core-ability/support)** and lose **[Leader](vsdata:core-ability/leader)**. Remove **CHARACTER** from their keywords. [Runes of Battle](vsdata:ability/aeldari.warlock-skyrunners.runes-of-battle) gives **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)** to the weapons carried by models in the unit.
